records.title: Hide to See: Reasoning-prefix Masking for Visual-anchored Thinking in VLM Distillation
records.reason: The paper studies reasoning-prefix masking as a VLM distillation/training objective; its primary abstract frames the contribution as distillation quality, not deployed inference efficiency.

records.title: Rethinking Importance Sampling in LLM Policy Optimization: A Cumulative Token Perspective
records.reason: The work changes importance sampling for LLM policy optimization during post-training; the primary abstract concerns policy-gradient training, not inference-time compute, memory, latency, or serving.

records.title: Read the Paper, Write the Code: Agentic Reproduction of Social-Science Results
records.reason: The paper evaluates agentic reproduction of social-science findings; the primary abstract describes reproducibility outcomes, not an LLM inference-efficiency method.

records.title: How Can We Synthesize High-Quality Pretraining Data? A Systematic Study of Prompt Design, Generator Model, and Source Data
records.reason: The full text studies synthetic pretraining-data generation and reports lower data-generation cost (including a 30x figure); the measured savings concern training-data production, not deployed model inference.
